text.general: General rules. A receipt is required for any single expense over 25 USD; without it the claim is rejected. Any claim over 1000 USD (after conversion) needs manager approval, so it is escalated to a human. Foreign-currency claims are converted at the fixed finance rates (EUR 1.10, GBP 1.27 per unit) before any cap is applied. A claim that duplicates an earlier one (same employee, merchant, date and amount) is rejected as a duplicate. Decision policy: any hard violation means reject; otherwise any soft violation means escalate to a human reviewer; otherwise approve.
text.meals: Meals. The cap is 75 USD per person per meal, computed as the USD total divided by the number of attendees. Alcohol is not reimbursable; a claim that contains an alcohol line is escalated so a human can approve a partial payment. Exceeding the per-person cap is escalated, not rejected.
text.lodging: Lodging. The cap is 250 USD per night, computed as the USD total divided by the number of nights. Exceeding the cap is escalated for a human to judge (conference rates, sold-out city).
text.airfare: Airfare. Economy cabin only. Premium economy, business and first class are rejected unless a pre-approval exists; the rejection is a hard violation.
text.ground_transport: Ground transport. Taxis, rideshare and rail up to 100 USD per trip are fine; above that the claim is escalated. The general receipt rule applies (over 25 USD needs a receipt).
text.software: Software and subscriptions. Every software purchase needs a valid pre-approval ticket (format PA-nnnn) whose category is software and whose limit covers the amount. No valid pre-approval is a hard violation and the claim is rejected.
text.client_gift: Client gifts. Always escalated to Compliance regardless of amount, because of anti-bribery rules. Gifts over 100 USD are additionally flagged as over the cap.
text.conference: Conference and training fees. Reimbursed with a receipt; the general over-1000-USD manager approval rule applies.
